The lease-based CAS fix in scheduler._contact_reply_retry_job is verified: 2 concurrent runs AND 3 concurrent runs on the same undelivered reply each produced EXACTLY 1 send_email call with retry_count=1, delivered=true, delivered_at + last_retry_at set. On-fail path (mailer 500) keeps delivered=false, retry_count=1, last_retry_at set, and 2 overlapping runs still produce exactly 1 send. Defect (2) could not be tested and a new P0 regression was introduced.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL REGRESSION: `loadState` is used at lines 77, 83, 84, 86 but never declared (no useState) and the useEffect was never updated to set it. Runtime ReferenceError 'loadState is not defined' crashes the component; because Profile.jsx has no error boundary, the whole /profile route renders as a blank page for boat_pro users (verified with a minted seed_marina session; pageerror captured). Fix: add `const [loadState, setLoadState] = useState("loading")` and rewrite the useEffect: on success -> setPhotos(data.photos||[]) + setLoadState('ready'); on 404 -> setPhotos([]) + 'ready'; on any other error -> setLoadState('error') WITHOUT clearing photos.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot verify the 401 load-error guard: component crashes before render, so data-testid='pro-photos-load-error' never appears and pro-photos-file is absent entirely. Happy path (200 with 2 existing photos) also crashes — thumbnails/upload are completely unavailable.
